analysis_unit: source_id; confidence intervals resample complete group_id clusters

feature_spec.decode: Pillow convert RGB; no EXIF transpose, ICC conversion, or alpha compositing; use normalized pipeline images

fft.aggregation: mean log1p(power) within each annulus, excluding the DC coefficient
fft.annuli: 16 equal-width radial frequency bins from 0 to sqrt(0.5**2 + 0.5**2) cycles/pixel; upper endpoint included

dct.blocks: non-overlapping 8x8 luminance blocks, aligned to the top-left
dct.aggregation: mean absolute magnitude of each coefficient over all 1024 blocks
dct.ordering: row-major frequency (u,v), excluding DC (0,0), after the 16 FFT features

training_spec.classifier: binary L2 logistic regression, positive label 1 is AI-generated
training_spec.standardization: training mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0) only; scales <= 1e-12 replaced by 1
training_spec.optimizer: deterministic Newton method with Armijo backtracking
training_spec.initialization: zero weights; intercept log(training positive fraction / negative fraction)
training_spec.nonconvergence: raise an error; never silently export an unconverged model
training_spec.tuning: none; fixed features, regularization, and stopping rule
